title: Blue Mountain Beach "Art of the Ocean" 60 Grande Beach Drive
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Art of the Ocean" 60 Grande Beach Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- On the Gulf- Private beach access- Located on a quiet cul-de-sac- Just a block away offers a health food boutique grocery, bakery, bike rental shop, restaurants, ice cream shop, and beachwear store- Newly renovated kitchen and primary bath- 5 adult bikes provided- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle will be provided- All bedrooms have flat-screen TV's- 1-car garage- Community pool- Propane grill- Second refrigerator located in the garage - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Once you step through the front door, you will find marble floors and rich woods teaming together to create an elegant beach atmosphere. The living room leads to a beautiful balcony offering a front-row seat to the breathtaking sunsets and sunrises over the shimmering water. This living room is adjacent to the recently renovated kitchen, featuring brand new appliances and gulf views! There is a guest bedroom on the main floor with a king bed and flat-screen TV. From the main level, you can travel downstairs to a perfect getaway for the kids. There are 2 sets of bunk beds and a Queen bed with a flat-screen TV, as well as a beautiful view overlooking the coast. The outdoor wooden furniture and propane grill make this the perfect area for family gatherings or a 4th of July barbecue. On the third floor of the home, you will find the Primary bedroom with a king bed, flat-screen TV, walk-in closet, and newly renovated primary bath that features an oversized tub, shower, and access to your own private balcony. Down the hall are two guest bedrooms, both with a private bathroom with a shower only. Whether you are one large family or a group of families vacationing together, this home is ideal for making long-lasting memories on 30A. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Bunk Room: 1 Full-over-Full bunk, 1 Twin-over-Twin bunk, 1 Queen Bed: Access to bathroom (shower only)SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Access to Bathroom (shower only)THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath (shower and tub) with large walk-in closet. Great Gulf views from private balcony! (Recently Renovated) - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
